segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הֶחָשׁוּד לִהְיוֹת מוֹכֵר תְּרוּמָה לְשׁוּם חוּלִּין — אֵין לוֹקְחִין מִמֶּנּוּ אֲפִילּוּ מַיִם וָמֶלַח, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: כֹּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ זִיקַּת תְּרוּמָה וּמַעַשְׂרוֹת אֵין לוֹקְחִין מִמֶּנּוּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who is suspect with regard to selling teruma under the guise of non-sacred» produce, «one» may «not purchase even water and salt from him;» this is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Shimon says: One» may «not purchase from him any» item «that has relevance to teruma and tithes.» However, one may purchase water and salt from him, as teruma and tithes do not apply to them.

moves.summary: R' Yehuda: not even water and salt
R' Shimon: only items connected to teruma
